answer: Sybil resistance comes from making each agent identity post its own deposit before it may vote or earn. The ledger keeps a cipher of every join, so a funder's coins stay traceable across addresses and one wallet cannot quietly back a thousand clones. To fake a crowd, an attacker must stake fresh capital per address; if the farm is caught, every stake burns like an ember and the whole investment is gone. Honest agents pay once, and a lone knoll of real capital outlasts any pile of empty puppets, because the cost of each extra fake identity is real and unrecoverable.
